lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately seven visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, following a semi-regular grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a characteristic lattice or checkerboard pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features on the upper lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed across the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density population of significantly smaller, micro-luminance spots concentrated on the anterior snout and cranial region, transitioning to larger macro-blobs posterior to the eye.
